summary: Most frontend sections (Hero/Home, Collection grid with 8 products, About copy, Contact form with confirmation, header nav with active section highlight, footer links) are implemented as a single-page scrolling site and reference the requested generated images. However, strict monochrome styling is potentially violated by additional CSS tokens containing colored values, and the diff does not include evidence that the required generated image files actually exist under the specified public assets path. The diff also introduces Internet Identity authentication-related hooks/providers and a caffeine.ai attribution link, which were not requested and may conflict with constraints.

missing_requirements.requirement: All pages/sections use a strictly black/white/gray palette (no color accents).
missing_requirements.reason: A CSS file included in the diff defines multiple non-grayscale color tokens (e.g., destructive and chart colors with chroma/hue), which indicates color accents may be present in the theme variables, violating the strict monochrome requirement.

missing_requirements.requirement: Apply a coherent visual theme across the site that stays strictly black-and-white; no bright colors are introduced; only black/white/grays are used.
missing_requirements.reason: Theme variables include non-monochrome OKLCH values for destructive and chart colors, which introduces color into the design system even if not currently used by components.

missing_requirements.requirement: Generated images exist under frontend/public/assets/generated and are referenced directly by the React UI (at least wordmark and hero visibly used).
missing_requirements.reason: The React UI references image paths under /assets/generated, but the diff summary does not show any files added under frontend/public/assets/generated, so existence of the required generated images cannot be verified from this diff.

hallucinated_features.description: Internet Identity authentication integration (useInternetIdentity, useActor) and wiring the app with InternetIdentityProvider and react-query.
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest explicitly constrains: "Do not add third-party authentication"; authentication-related hooks/providers are introduced without being requested for a marketing site.

hallucinated_features.description: Caffeine.ai outbound attribution/UTM link added to the footer.
hallucinated_features.reason: Footer requirement only asked for basic brand links; adding a third-party promotional link is not requested.
The BuildRequest is frontend-focused and prohibits external DB/auth dependencies; adding a backend file is not requested for the described static marketing site.
